description: Returns native and major-token balances of up to 3 addresses (at most one EVM, one Solana, one Tron) across every matching chain in one call. Coverage: native coin + USDC, USDT, DAI, EURC, bridged USDC, WETH and WBTC where they exist on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche and BNB Chain; SOL + USDC/USDT on Solana; TRX + USDT/USDC on Tron; plus up to 10 custom tokens. Each chain includes the block number read and the response includes a stablecoin face-value total. Cost and side effects: this calls the hosted paid endpoint and costs 0.002 USDC per call via x402 on Base. It pays only if X402_PRIVATE_KEY (or EVM_PRIVATE_KEY) is set in this server's environment. It checks that the quote is USDC on Base, goes to the DevX wallet and is at most 0.01 USDC before signing. Without a key it pays nothing and returns {payment_required: true, url, quote, how_to_pay}. Use it when you need a full portfolio view or several chains at once. For one chain's native + stablecoin, basic_balance is free. Returns (paid): per-address, per-chain native and token balances with blocks, a summary and a _payment receipt.

addresses.description: 1-3 addresses, at most one per family: EVM address (0x + 40 hex), Solana address (base58, 32-44 chars) or Tron address (T + 33 base58 chars).

chains.description: Limit to these chains. Default: every chain that matches the given address families.

tokens.description: Up to 10 extra tokens as chain:address, e.g. base:0x4ed4e862860bed51a9570b96d89af5e1b0efefed or solana:<mint>. Tokens outside the built-in list are not discovered automatically.
